workflow: 按批次、编号顺序核对discovered-buildings，确认后追加production_queue；保留源ID，不重复建模
逐条读取discovered-streets，抽取具体建筑及可用照片／文字；新发现追加，不声称已查遍
每栋保存来源、明确估计、制作资产、检查、提交并更新README
仅暂存新增修改；不得提交本地清理删除

execution_policy.instruction_source: 2026-10-31 user instruction: autonomously complete models in sequence without requiring repeated per-model prompts
execution_policy.progression: After each bounded model delivery is validated and published, retire its completed task and continue the next unfinished item in production order.
execution_policy.unresolved_scope: Retain unmodeled components and source gaps explicitly; do not invent measured dimensions or completed unseen structures.
